### Bible Pathways - June 14, 2005
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-june-14-2005-1335235.html
Passage: Esther 8:1
Points:
- God sovereignly governs earthly affairs and overturns the destructive schemes formed against His people.
- The Lord works through faithful, obedient individuals to influence secular rulers and fulfill His redemptive plans.
- While seasons of comfort can breed spiritual neglect, crises remind believers of their daily dependence on God.
- Believers living in hostile or worldly cultures are called to stand boldly in faith against opposition.
- Mordecai's exaltation from humble servant to ruler beside the king foreshadows Christ's ultimate exaltation.
